snippet.title: Coin Shower - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Coin Shower on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5381280/Coin_Shower/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=own_channel&utm_campaign=announcement

Coin Shower is a short, cozy incremental casino arcade game. Every machine pays out in a burst of coins that pile up on the floor. Scoop them up, spend them on upgrades, unlock new machines, and chase the $1,000,000 moon shot.

FEATURES
• A lineup of slot and arcade machines to unlock, each with its own way to win, its own upgrades and its own max win
• Every win pays out in physical coins that bounce, pile up and stay on the floor until you scoop them
• Upgrades for the machines and for you: auto-spin, coin collectors, wider grabs, bigger multipliers
• Plushies to win, each with its own power, and the powers stack
• Play at your own pace: let auto-spin run, or raise the bet and go for the moon shot

Is this gambling? No. The coins are fictional and Coin Shower will never ask you for real money.

#CoinShower #IndieGame #IncrementalGame
